docs.text: The Moonlight Aquarium opens Tuesday through Sunday from 10:00 to 18:00. The aquarium is closed on Monday. On Thursday, general admission is free after 16:00. Visitors still need a timed-entry ticket.

Tram line 4 runs from Central Station to Harbor Square every 12 minutes. The aquarium is a five-minute walk from Harbor Square. A free weekend shuttle runs every 20 minutes from Central Station to the aquarium. The last shuttle departs at 17:30.
The aquarium has step-free entry at the east gate. Elevators serve every exhibit floor. Wheelchairs can be borrowed without charge at the information desk. Advance reservation is recommended.

The jellyfish feeding talk begins at 15:00 every day the aquarium is open. Seats are first come, first served. The night-ocean exhibit stays open until 21:00 on the first Friday of each month. Special-entry tickets are required.
The Tidal Café serves lunch from 11:00 to 15:00. Vegan dishes and nut-free snacks are available. Outside food is allowed at the harbor terrace picnic tables, but not inside the aquarium exhibits.
